en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view over the River Danube in Budapest. In the foreground is a large suspension bridge spanning the river, with numerous boats and steamships on the water. On the left bank are hills with dense buildings and a large palace complex; on the right bank stretches a flat urban riverside with grand city buildings. At the top left in red print is the title identifying Budapest and the Danube view in Hungarian and German.
